# site/dist/index.html

## What it is
The generated standalone VIBE page deployed at benjiapps.com/apps/vibe.

## How to navigate it
Full document shell (meta description, Open Graph tags, title, inline favicon), then the head and body copied from site/vibe.html, with a "back to benjiapps" link added in the nav.

## What it interacts with
- Generated by site/build_page.py from site/vibe.html; checked by site/check_page.py.
- Favicon is an inline SVG data URL; loads Google Fonts; links to GitHub releases and benjiapps.com/vibe/apt.

## Why it exists
A hosted page needs its own full document shell; this is that output.

## Helpful notes
Generated, do not hand-edit; change site/vibe.html and rerun site/build_page.py. As of this note it matches a fresh build.
